items.title: First aid Treatment for Dislocation and Sprain (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: First aid Treatment for Dislocation and Sprain: a main subheading of 12.2 Disorders of the skeletal system, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 272-273.

blocks.text: Dislocation aur sprain ki first aid (fauri tibbi madad) ke yeh qadam hain (Fig. 12.18):

items: Mutasira hisse ko hilne na dein: utre hue jor ko khud seedha karne ki koshish na karein. Bazu ya taang ko sahara dene ke liye sling ya splint (patti ya takhti) istemal karein.
bold: Mutasira hisse ko hilne na dein:

blocks.alt: Chaar numbered tasveerein: 1 Immobilize the affected area (dastanay pehne haath takhne par patti bandhte hain, aur ek aurat ka bazu sling mein hai); 2 Apply ice (haath ghutne par barf ki thaili rakhta hai); 3 Elevate the affected limb (leta hua aadmi jis ka zakhmi bazu aur patti wali taang takiyon par oonchi hai); 4 Seek medical attention (hospital mein doctor mareez ke kandhe par haath rakhta hai).
blocks.caption: Figure 12.18: Dislocation ya sprain ka first aid (kitab ki Figure 12.18 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Barf lagayein: soojan aur dard kam karne ke liye mutasira jagah par barf ki thaili ya thandi patti rakhein.
Mutasira hissa ooncha rakhein: dislocation mein, agar mumkin ho, soojan kam karne ke liye bazu ya taang ko (dil ki satah se) ooncha rakhein.
Doctor ki madad lein: dislocation aur sprain dono mein tibbi madad zaroori hai, is liye emergency service 1122 ko call karein ya mareez ko mazeed muaine aur ilaj ke liye hospital le jayein.

blocks.prompt: Ek 70 sala khatoon jo shaz-o-nadir warzish karti aur tawil arse se corticosteroids leti hai, mamooli girne se kalai tor leti hai. Mumkina bunyadi kaifiyat ka naam batayein aur un ki kahani ke khatre ke awamil ginwayein.
blocks.explanation: Osteoporosis: un ki haddi ki kasafat gir gai hai, to haddiyan nazuk hain aur asani se tootti hain. Khatre ke awamil umr, menopause ke baad oestrogen ki kami, wazan uthane wali warzish ki kami aur corticosteroids ka tawil istemal hain; calcium aur vitamin D se khali khoorak, smoking ya sharab khatra barhatin.

items: Disc slip: disc ki bahar wali tah phat kar andar ka gel nerve ko dabata hai. Spondylosis: vertebrae aur discs ka ghisna, bone outgrowths; zyada tar gardan aur kamar mein. Sciatica: sciatic nerve ka dabna; dard kamar se taang tak.
Arthritis: osteoarthritis (articular cartilage ghis jati hai; ghutna, koolha, reerh), rheumatoid (autoimmune, synovial membrane mein sozish; kalai, haath), gout (uric acid crystals; bara angootha).
Osteoporosis: haddi ki kasafat kam; wajahen umar, menopause, calcium aur vitamin D ki kami, warzish na karna, corticosteroids, smoking aur sharab.
Dislocation: haddiyan jor se bahar nikal jati hain; doctor bithata hai. Sprain: ligaments khinch ya phat jate hain (takhna, ghutna, kalai).
First aid: hilne na dein, barf lagayein, ooncha rakhein, 1122 par call karein ya hospital le jayein.
